subject: Controller Layout
object: LP Square, RP Triangle, LK Cross, RK Circle
text: The controller uses LP = Left Punch (square), RP = Right Punch (triangle), LK = Left Kick (cross), and RK = Right Kick (circle).

evidence.quote: LP = Left Punch (square)...RP = Right Punch (triangle)...LK = Left Kick (cross)...RK = Right Kick (circle)

subject: Key Configuration
object: Title Screen/Test Mode/ Options Mode/Key Config/
text: Setting where the top buttons are assigned tasks is accessible via the Title Screen/Test Mode/ Options Mode/Key Config/.

evidence.quote: You can set the controllers to setting where the top buttons are assigned tasks, this is accessible via the Title Screen/Test Mode/ Options Mode/Key Config/.

subject: Free Setting
text: Under Free Setting buttons are assigned with L1 = pressing LP/LK simutaneously, R1 = pressing RP/RK simutaneously, L2 = pressing LK/RK simutaneously, and R2 = pressing LP/RP simutaneously.

evidence.quote: Free Setting selected...L1 = pressing LP/LK simutaneously...R1 = pressing RP/RK simutaneously...L2 = pressing LK/RK simutaneously...R2 = pressing LP/RP simutaneously

subject: Dashing
object: Forward F, F and Backward B, B
text: Dashing forward requires Forward: F, F and dashing backward requires Backward: B, B.

evidence.quote:
Forward: F, F
	Backward: B, B

subject: Running Attacks
text: Running attacks approximately 1-2 screen lengths from opponent use Run: F, F, F press any keypad to interrupt run.

evidence.quote: Running Attacks: (approx. 1-2 screen lengths from opponent)...Run: F, F, F (press any keypad to interrupt run)

subject: Recovery Attacks
object: Tap U straight up, tap F roll forward, tap B roll backward, B+(LK+RK) kick up attack
text: Recovery attacks include Striaght Up: repeatedly tap U, Roll Forward: repeatledly tap F, Roll Backward: repeatedly tap B, and Kick Up Attack: B + (LK+RK).

evidence.quote: Striaght Up: repeatedly tap U...Roll Forward: repeatledly tap F...Roll Backward: repeatedly tap B...Kick Up Attack: B + (LK+RK)

subject: Ground Attacks
object: Low Pounce U + RP anytime, High Pounce U + RP hold both
text: Ground attacks include Low Pounce: U + RP (anytime) and High Pounce: U + RP (hold both for duration of move).

evidence.quote: Ground Attacks:...Low Pounce: U + RP (anytime)...High Pounce: U + RP (hold both for duration of move)

subject: 10-Attack Strings
object: Series of punch/kick attacks doing considerable damage
text: The 10-Attack Strings are a series of punch/kick attacks characters can execute that do considerable amount of damage on your opponent.

evidence.quote: The 10-Attack Strings are a series of punch/kick attacks characters can execute. If successfully executed, these attacks can do a considerable amount of damage on your opponent.

subject: Unblockable Attacks
object: Cannot be blocked and do considerable damage
text: Unblockable attacks generally take a while to execute, but if they connect these attacks cannot be blocked and do considerable damage.

evidence.quote: These attacks generally take a while to execute...If they do connect, these attacks cannot be blocked and do considerable damage.

subject: Throws
object: All throws must be performed at very close range, basic throw moves LP/LK, RP/RK
text: All throws must be performed at a very close range, and every player has two basic throw moves (LP/LK, RP/RK).

evidence.quote: all throws must be performed at a very close range...every player has two basic throw moves (LP/LK, RP/RK)
